subtasks: Pour all the balls from the cup into the vase.
Turn the empty yellow cup upright, place it securely on the tabletop away from the scattered balls, and release it.
Pick up the small brown balls on the tabletop to the right of the yellow cup and place them inside the black vase.
Fully open both grippers, lift the right fingers clear of the tabletop, and return both robot arms to their initial resting poses.
